differences.reason: The record reads a COMMENT card's text as nothing - value and comment both empty - so the commentary a FITS file carries is lost; this exporter keeps the text as the card's comment, as the file states it.
The record states BITPIX 1 for an eight-bit image, a count of bytes per sample rather than the file's card; this exporter keeps the file's 8.

The record rewrites the offset of an unsigned sixteen-bit file to the 0 its unsigned samples carry once offset; this exporter keeps the file's card. The samples are the same, as the payload digest shows.

The record rewrites the offset of an unsigned thirty-two-bit file to the 0 its unsigned samples carry once offset; this exporter keeps the file's card. The samples are the same, as the payload digest shows.

The record states a signed-byte file's offset with the wrong sign; the file's card is -128, the FITS convention for signed bytes, and this exporter keeps it. The samples are the same, as the payload digest shows.
The record appends a BZERO card describing in-memory samples to a file that holds none; this exporter writes only the cards the file holds.
The record appends a BSCALE card describing in-memory samples to a file that holds none; this exporter writes only the cards the file holds.
The record appends NAXIS3 = 1 to a single-plane file whose header has two axes; this exporter writes only the cards the file holds.
The record invents FITS structural cards for an XISF file, which holds none; this exporter writes only what the file states.
The record invents FITS structural cards for an XISF file, which holds none; this exporter writes only what the file states.
This engine reads an XISF image's colour space, image type and bounds as cards of the XISF namespace; the record does not carry them.
This engine reads an XISF image's colour space, image type and bounds as cards of the XISF namespace; the record does not carry them.
This engine reads an XISF image's colour space, image type and bounds as cards of the XISF namespace; the record does not carry them.
This engine reads an XISF unit's own metadata - the application that wrote it, when, and with which codecs - as cards of the XISF namespace; the record does not carry them.
This engine reads a PNG file's colour type as a card; the record carries no card of a PNG file.
This engine reads the Exif and TIFF tags a TIFF, PNG or JPEG file holds as cards; the record carries no card of those containers.
